name: code-ontology-companion
description: A local ontology data pipeline for authorized Java/Spring and Python code. Generate typed graphs, source evidence and snapshot lineage; serve bounded knowledge through local MCP and explore the same ontology in offline HTML.

interface.longDescription: Turn authorized Java/Spring and Python source into typed ontology graphs with auditable relationship evidence and immutable local snapshots. This local data pipeline preserves source scope and snapshot lineage, exports RDF 1.1 Turtle with a documented PROV-O subset, and serves selected JSON evidence through local MCP. Start with a relevant symbol search or bounded static impact lookup through actually exposed local MCP tools; use the verified bundled CLI when needed. The complete local package provides eleven read-only tools, including pinned module-catalog queries and bounded evidence bundles. An offline 3D workbench in HTML provides structure, impact and changes views, keyboard and text routes, complete paged inventory, source evidence, and visible coverage limits. Deterministic analysis does not execute target code or make network requests. Static relationships do not prove runtime behavior or current authorization. Inspect rule-attributed relationship evidence and adapter coverage, including unresolved boundaries. Optional separately authorized local inference remains outside observed evidence.
capabilities: Local code-to-ontology data pipeline with snapshot lineage
Current-conversation application with an actual first lookup
Capability-aware routing and authorized change checkpoints
Offline 3D structure, impact, and changes workbench
Exact symbol search and pinned snapshot reads
Directional static dependency paths with source evidence
Auditable relationship evidence and adapter coverage
Selected portable code references and RDF export
Keyboard navigation and accessible paged text fallback
Three display depths and one/two/three-hop call highlights
Complete indexed inventory through explicit expansion and pagination
Persistent source-root selection and duplicate-declaration detection
Bounded static evidence bundles for source-backed answers
Local privacy checks for supported generated outputs
defaultPrompt: Apply Code Ontology Companion to this project and use it to help with my current task.
If I change OrderService, what code may be affected? Show static evidence and runtime limitations.
Use the ontology products available here for this task, starting with a real lookup or selected-artifact check.
